= camel semantic audit

Retrieve retained expert evaluations and related lifecycle records


== Usage

[source,bash]
----
camel semantic audit [options]
----

[cols="2,5,1,2",options="header"]
|===
| Option | Description | Default | Type
| `--breadcrumb-id` | Filter by Camel breadcrumb ID |  | String
| `--case-event-id` | Retrieve a source-local case anchored at this event |  | String
| `--category` | Filter by record category: evaluation or request |  | String
| `--cursor` | Opaque cursor for an older page; retain the original filters |  | String
